ammo_box._doc: Ammo boxes (Update 02 section 4, T-049): hold use to refill the weapon in hand (mag + reserve) and lethal grenades (not tacticals). Price by what you hold: normal / Crucible-upgraded (T-083: the boxes are the only counter for a taught gun's ammo besides its wall chalk; the Crucible sells none), wonder weapons (class wonder) wonder / wonder_upgraded. grenades_only = the price when the gun is full but grenades are short (or nothing is held). cooldown_s = per player, after a purchase.

bonuses._doc: In-match Scrip bonuses (T-078, docs/gravelight/ECONOMY.md). Paid by gravelight/autoload/scrip_bonuses.gd on the host, without the Double Scrip multiplier, each with a HUD toast (GLBus.bonus_awarded). round_pay: every player standing (not downed, not bled out) when a round ends gets base + per_round x round, capped at max. clean_round: extra for a round in which that player took no hit at all (untouched + untouched_per_round x round, capped) and for one in which they never went down (no_down). headshot_streak: every `every` headshot kills in a row (any other kill by that player, or going down, resets it) pays base + step x (streak / every - 1), capped at max. salvage: a kill drops dog tags (a small pickup) with `chance` (chance_late from late_from_round on); they are worth value_base + value_per_round x round (capped), drift to a standing player within magnet_m, are picked up within pickup_radius, blink from blink_from_s and are gone at lifetime_s; at most max_alive on the map and max_per_round per round.

_returned_kill_doc: UPDATE 07 (T-105): Scrip for a zombie flung off a drop or into vacuum by the Lodestone (Zombie.external_push's kill plane).
_ballast_load_bonus_doc: UPDATE 10 (T-153): Scrip to the carrier for each coffin loaded on Totenhafen's crane (Ballast v2; the Operator is pleased).
